notes.content:
Hello community, I've been extra busy at the end of the year with various things and I've contracted COVID in the last week and I need a little time to recover!
I'm sorry to keep you all waiting! *cough *cough

notes.title: Workshop's development progress!
notes.content:
I've been working on the code for the Workshop and level editor recently and I'm making pretty good progress so far. Players can build and upload their own levels in-game and download levels uploaded by other players from the workshop.
I've gone through the whole process and I'm now working on the UI for the level editor and I think the level editor and workshop will be available to everyone soon!

notes.title: Future update plans!
notes.content:
Future update plans:
1. We just have too few levels (I'm sorry) and I think I need to add Workshop support to the game so that players can build and upload their own levels.

2. I should be adding volume controls shortly, but it should be after the Workshop update!

Thanks again for your patience and support!

notes.title: New feature update!
notes.content: We recently received a lot of feedback from players: they want to be able to control the camera angle, so we added this feature! Enjoy!

notes.title: Fixed the bug in the video setting interface
notes.content: Hello everyone, we saw some bug feedback from players yesterday, so we fixed a bug today where the settings in the UI video settings screen did not take effect！

notes.title: Sorry for the delay guys
notes.content: We are fixing some bugs and expect to release the game within a week!
